name: Braha'tok
description: The Braha'tok was a Braha'tok-class gunship under the command of Kiles L'toth in the Dornean Navy. In 4 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, the planet Dornea loaned the Braha'tok—along with its sister ship, the Torktarak—to the Alliance Fleet for its attack on the second Death Star battle station above the Forest Moon of Endor.
